description: Every pinned version in this repository is updated only through a Renovate pull request, which builds, tests and publishes pr-N like any other. Apt packages float by design and are not tracked.

customManagers.description: Versions pinned in any Dockerfile by an ARG <NAME>_VERSION (in a smoke script, a plain <NAME>_VERSION=) directly below a `# renovate: datasource=… depName=… [packageName=…] [versioning=…] [extractVersion=…]` comment

packageRules.description: Child Dockerfiles default BASE_IMAGE to our own image for plain local builds; CI always builds them on this commit's parent. Never pin or bump it.
Digests of our own images (.devcontainer.json, the Coder template): one grouped weekly pull request, because every merge to main publishes a new edge digest
